newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises rediscount rate for July.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises rediscount rate for July.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had raised its rediscount rate to 9.969 percent for July, up 7.7 basis points from 9.892 percent in June.
The rediscount rate is one percentage point below the average 91-day Treasury bill rate posted in the last auction in June. The rate is adjusted at the start of every month.
The Central Bank lends money to banks under its rediscounting facility. Banks in turn re-lend the funds to exporters and agriculture-based businessmen.
A total of 3.904 billion pesos had been disbursed in the first six months of the year.
